name: Network of Community Ministries
hoursNotes: Community Food Market shopping is by appointment during these hours; new clients first visit in person to register.
requirements: Resident of the 14 ZIP codes within Richardson ISD boundaries; income at or below 185% of federal poverty guidelines. Bring proof of address and income if you can — inability to provide documents does not affect eligibility for food.
notes: Also offers a clothing closet, senior services, and youth programs.
